narr: Isolated thunderstorms moved west across southeast Arizona during the afternoon and evening. Localized flash flooding occurred in the Tucson Metro area.
ev: Heavy rain of 1-1.5 in 90 minutes caused flash flooding in Saguaro National Park and damage to Bajada Loop Rd.

Heavy rain of more than 1 in 1 hour caused flash flooding and closures of residential streets south of Orange Grove Road between La Cholla and La Canada. Additionally, a man was rescued after becoming trapped under a bridge by floodwaters near Blacklidge and Walnut.
lsr: TUCSON DOT CLOSED ROAD DUE TO FLOODING.
NATIONAL PARK SERVICE REPORTED FLOOD DAMAGE TO BAJADA LOOP ROAD AT SAGUARO NATIONAL PARK WEST. THE LOOP REMAINS CLOSED UP TO TWO DAYS FOR REPAIRS. TIMING ESTIMATED BY RADAR.
